explicit_boundary: not true soil moisture; no missing-to-zero imputation

primary_risk_mechanism: 強風造成失溫增強、平衡與裝備控制問題
explicit_boundary: station wind may not represent local ridge gust

hazard_family_name_zh: 霧／低雲／能見度低／導航劣化
primary_risk_mechanism: 低能見度造成辨識路徑、岔路與方向判斷困難
explicit_boundary: not actual lost event; requires behavior layer for迷航 confirmation

hazard_family_name_zh: 雷雨／雷擊／短延時強降雨
primary_risk_mechanism: 對流雷雨造成雷擊、短時強降雨與突發陣風
explicit_boundary: lightning cannot be inferred reliably from rain alone

hazard_family_name_zh: 溪水暴漲／邊坡滑落／土石流
primary_risk_mechanism: 降雨觸發溪流水位上升、邊坡不穩與土石流
explicit_boundary: not direct weather; missing water level is not safe zero

hazard_family_name_zh: 颱風／鋒面／東北季風／氣壓急變
primary_risk_mechanism: 大尺度天氣系統造成連續雨、強風、濕冷或快速惡化
explicit_boundary: single-station rows insufficient for full synoptic classification

primary_risk_mechanism: 空污或煙霾增加活動呼吸負擔
explicit_boundary: not purely weather; requires external air-quality data

hazard_family_name_zh: 地震／落石／崩塌／步道封閉
primary_risk_mechanism: 地震或地質事件造成邊坡鬆動、落石與通行中斷
explicit_boundary: earthquake is not meteorological and cannot be derived from weather DB
